entries.title: II Samuel 22:1
segments: ¶Then David spoke to the LORD the words of this song, on the day when the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:2
segments: ¶And he said: "The LORD [is] my rock and my fortress and my deliverer;

entries.title: II Samuel 22:3
segments: The God of my strength, in whom I will trust; My shield and the horn of my salvation, My stronghold and my refuge; My Savior, You save me from violence.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:4
segments: I will call upon the LORD, [who is worthy] to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:5
segments: 'When the waves of death surrounded me, The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:6
segments: The sorrows of Sheol surrounded me; The snares of death confronted me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:7
segments: In my distress I called upon the LORD, And cried out to my God; He heard my voice from His temple, And my cry [entered] His ears.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:8
segments: "Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, Because He was angry.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:9
segments: Smoke went up from His nostrils, And devouring fire from His mouth; Coals were kindled by it.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:10
segments: He bowed the heavens also, and came down With darkness under His feet.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:11
segments: He rode upon a cherub, and flew; And He was seen upon the wings of the wind.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:12
segments: He made darkness canopies around Him, Dark waters [and] thick clouds of the skies.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:13
segments: From the brightness before Him Coals of fire were kindled.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:14
segments: "The LORD thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered His voice.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:15
segments: He sent out arrows and scattered them; Lightning bolts, and He vanquished them.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:16
segments: Then the channels of the sea were seen, The foundations of the world were uncovered, At the rebuke of the LORD, At the blast of the breath of His nostrils.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:17
segments: "He sent from above, He took me, He drew me out of many waters.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:18
segments: He delivered me from my strong enemy, From those who hated me; For they were too strong for me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:19
segments: They confronted me in the day of my calamity, But the LORD was my support.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:20
segments: He also brought me out into a broad place; He delivered me because He delighted in me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:21
segments: "The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands He has recompensed me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:22
segments: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, And have not wickedly departed from my God.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:23
segments: For all His judgments [were] before me; And [as for] His statutes, I did not depart from them.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:24
segments: I was also blameless before Him, And I kept myself from my iniquity.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:25
segments: Therefore the LORD has recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in His eyes.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:26
segments: "With the merciful You will show Yourself merciful; With a blameless man You will show Yourself blameless;

entries.title: II Samuel 22:27
segments: With the pure You will show Yourself pure; And with the devious You will show Yourself shrewd.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:28
segments: You will save the humble people; But Your eyes [are] on the haughty, [that] You may bring [them] down.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:29
segments: "For You [are] my lamp, O LORD; The LORD shall enlighten my darkness.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:30
segments: For by You I can run against a troop; By my God I can leap over a wall.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:31
segments: [As for] God, His way [is] perfect; The word of the LORD [is] proven; He [is] a shield to all who trust in Him.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:32
segments: "For who [is] God, except the LORD? And who [is] a rock, except our God?

entries.title: II Samuel 22:33
segments: God [is] my strength [and] power, And He makes my way perfect.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:34
segments: He makes my feet like the [feet] of deer, And sets me on my high places.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:35
segments: He teaches my hands to make war, So that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:36
segments: "You have also given me the shield of Your salvation; Your gentleness has made me great.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:37
segments: You enlarged my path under me; So my feet did not slip.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:38
segments: "I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them; Neither did I turn back again till they were destroyed.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:39
segments: And I have destroyed them and wounded them, So that they could not rise; They have fallen under my feet.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:40
segments: For You have armed me with strength for the battle; You have subdued under me those who rose against me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:41
segments: You have also given me the necks of my enemies, So that I destroyed those who hated me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:42
segments: They looked, but [there was] none to save; [Even] to the LORD, but He did not answer them.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:43
segments: Then I beat them as fine as the dust of the earth; I trod them like dirt in the streets, [And] I spread them out.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:44
segments: "You have also delivered me from the strivings of my people; You have kept me as the head of the nations. A people I have not known shall serve me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:45
segments: The foreigners submit to me; As soon as they hear, they obey me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:46
segments: The foreigners fade away, And come frightened from their hideouts.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:47
segments: "The LORD lives! Blessed [be] my Rock! Let God be exalted, The Rock of my salvation!

entries.title: II Samuel 22:48
segments: [It is] God who avenges me, And subdues the peoples under me;

entries.title: II Samuel 22:49
segments: He delivers me from my enemies. You also lift me up above those who rise against me; You have delivered me from the violent man.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:50
segments: Therefore I will give thanks to You, O LORD, among the Gentiles, And sing praises to Your name.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:51
segments: [He is] the tower of salvation to His king, And shows mercy to His anointed, To David and his descendants forevermore."
